title: Car dongle
description: Carlinkit U2AC mainline firmware: per-drive health from the flight log, sent by the home upload (Pushgateway job u2ac).

options.content: **One bar or row per drive** (the dongle's flight-log number). A drive's numbers arrive at the start of the next drive from home, so the newest drive shows up then. Start-up times are seconds from power-on. Hover a panel title for what it measures.

panels.title: AA on screen
panels.description: Seconds from power-on until Android Auto was on the car screen.

panels.title: On hotspot
panels.description: Seconds from power-on until the phone reported it joined the dongle's Wi-Fi.

panels.title: Drive length
panels.description: How long the dongle was powered (within a minute: it records once a minute).

targets.expr: max(u2ac_drive_seconds and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_drive_seconds))))

panels.title: Drops
panels.description: Times Android Auto stopped and restarted during the drive.

targets.expr: max(u2ac_drive_drops and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_drive_drops))))

panels.title: Peak temp
panels.description: Highest chip temperature during the drive. It throttles at 85 °C.

targets.expr: max(u2ac_drive_temperature_max_celsius and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_drive_temperature_max_celsius))))

panels.title: Worst signal
panels.description: Weakest Wi-Fi signal from the phone during the drive (closer to 0 is better).

targets.expr: max(u2ac_drive_signal_min_dbm and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_drive_signal_min_dbm))))

panels.title: Data relayed
panels.description: Wi-Fi data between phone and dongle during the drive (mostly the video to the car).

targets.expr: (max(u2ac_drive_rx_bytes and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_drive_rx_bytes))))) + (max(u2ac_drive_tx_bytes and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_drive_tx_bytes)))))

panels.title: Started
panels.description: Wall-clock start of the latest drive that began at home (only those drives learn the time).

targets.expr: max(u2ac_drive_start_timestamp_seconds and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_drive_start_timestamp_seconds)))) * 1000

panels.title: Last upload
panels.description: When the dongle last sent its drive logs.

panels.title: Drives
panels.description: Drives with Android Auto in the selected time range.

panels.title: Slow or failed starts
panels.description: Power-ons with no Android Auto session in the first 90 s (a phone VPN, Bluetooth off, no phone).

panels.title: Hotspot devices
panels.description: Different devices that joined the dongle's Wi-Fi in the latest drive. More than 1 means not only your phone.

targets.expr: max(u2ac_drive_hotspot_devices and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_drive_hotspot_devices))))

panels.title: How it started
panels.description: What started the dongle for the latest drive: a power-on is normal; a reboot or the watchdog is not.

targets.expr: max(((u2ac_last_reset{cause="power"} * 1) or (u2ac_last_reset{cause="software"} * 2) or (u2ac_last_reset{cause="watchdog"} * 3) or (u2ac_last_reset{cause="unknown"} * 4)) and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_last_reset))))

panels.title: Repairs
panels.description: Radio daemon repairs plus relay restarts in the latest drive.

targets.expr: (max(u2ac_drive_radio_repairs and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_drive_radio_repairs))))) + (max(u2ac_drive_relay_restarts and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_drive_relay_restarts)))))

panels.title: Where the start-up time goes
panels.description: Per drive, stacked: power-on until the dongle calls the phone over Bluetooth, then until the phone is on the dongle's Wi-Fi, then until the car shows Android Auto. The bar's height is the time to Android Auto.

panels.title: Latest drive, step by step
panels.description: Seconds from power-on to each step of the latest drive's start.

targets.expr: max(u2ac_aa_event_seconds{event="bt_try"} and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_aa_event_seconds{event="bt_try"}))))

panels.title: All drives
panels.description: One row per flight-log entry, newest first. Dashes: not recorded by that firmware or not known (start times exist only for drives that began at home).

targets.expr: (max by (log_seq, why) (max_over_time(u2ac_flightlog_info[$__range]))) or on(log_seq) (max by (log_seq) (max_over_time(u2ac_flightlog_seq[$__range])) * NaN)

(max by (log_seq) ((max by (log_seq) (max_over_time(u2ac_last_reset{cause="power"}[$__range])) * 1) or (max by (log_seq) (max_over_time(u2ac_last_reset{cause="software"}[$__range])) * 2) or (max by (log_seq) (max_over_time(u2ac_last_reset{cause="watchdog"}[$__range])) * 3) or (max by (log_seq) (max_over_time(u2ac_last_reset{cause="unknown"}[$__range])) * 4))) or on(log_seq) (max by (log_seq) (max_over_time(u2ac_flightlog_seq[$__range])) * NaN)

panels.title: Data relayed
panels.description: Wi-Fi data between phone and dongle per drive (mostly the video to the car).

panels.title: Peak temperature
panels.description: Highest chip temperature per drive.

panels.title: Worst phone signal
panels.description: Weakest Wi-Fi signal from the phone per drive.

panels.title: Drive length
panels.description: How long the dongle was powered per drive.

panels.title: Upload time
panels.description: How long the latest upload took (it starts before the hotspot; the limit is 4 s at a car start).

targets.expr: max(u2ac_home_upload_seconds and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_home_upload_seconds))))

panels.title: Home Wi-Fi signal
panels.description: Signal of the home network where the car was parked, at the latest upload.

targets.expr: max(u2ac_home_upload_signal_dbm and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_home_upload_signal_dbm))))

panels.title: Old lease used
panels.description: 1 when DHCP did not answer in time and the dongle used its last address.

targets.expr: max(u2ac_home_upload_lease_reused and on(log_seq) (u2ac_flightlog_seq == scalar(max(u2ac_flightlog_seq and on(log_seq) u2ac_home_upload_lease_reused))))

panels.title: Upload time per drive
panels.description: Per drive, the time each step of its upload took: find the network, join it, get an address (the rest is sending).
